title: Colonal Barrel
description: Add Pink Slime to the face of your Barrels!
body:
The Colonal Barrel Resource Pack adds Colonals signature Pink Slime to the face of Barrels!

It is themed around Colonal's love of Pink Slime, and optimized for to be used in the [Colonal Mod Pack (CMP)](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/modpacks/colonal-pack).
